summary: Whether Claude, OpenAI, GitHub and Cloudflare are up, with their open incidents and maintenance.
notes: Reads each service's public Statuspage summary from status.claude.com, status.openai.com, www.githubstatus.com and www.cloudflarestatus.com. Type a name to find a service, component or incident. A page that cannot be read shows only that service as unavailable. Return opens the status page or the incident. Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, Cloudflare or Atlassian Statuspage.
